name: Hierarchical Data Loading and Abstraction
aliases: yt Data Loading and Hierarchy Construction
definition: A mechanism to abstract simulation data into physical objects. It separates dataset metadata (time, units, domain size) from geometric structure (grid hierarchy), allowing data from different codes to be compared in memory.
summary: Hierarchical Data Loading and Abstraction is a lightweight, domain-specific mechanism for astrophysical AMR data that separates metadata from geometry and uses lazy loading to ensure negligible memory overhead until specific regions are queried.
